finalists.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
finalists.why: It has the most specific findings for it, including bilateral sinusitis and granular shadows on the chest X-ray and CT.

finalists.label: Lymphomatoid Granulomatosis
finalists.why: It has specific findings for it, including a tumor in the center and diffuse granular shadows on the chest X-ray and CT, with no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: Wegener's granulomatosis is chosen because its findings, such as bilateral sinusitis and bronchial wall thickening, are more closely aligned with the vignette's description of the patient's condition.
